messages:
Samir K.: Heads up — we're seeing spikes of 413s from embeddings when clients send long arrays with per-item 'dims' fields. I prototyped a stricter validation patch but worried about causing rollouts.

Lina T.: Can you paste an example payload and the error? Is this size or dimensionality mismatch?

Samir K.: Example (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "embed-large-v1",
  "input": [
    { "text": "foo", "dims": 1536 },
    { "text": "bar", "dims": 1536 }
  ]
}
```
Error seen: `413 Payload Too Large` and occasionally `422 dim mismatch` when a client sends a different dims than the model.

Roberta (eng-runtime): Looks like many clients are shipping an explicit `dims` per item; we historically ignore it. The new validator is computing the serialized size by summing vectors and rejects > 5MB. That explains the 413.

Kevin J.: Two quick axes: (1) Use 422 for semantic errors (dims mismatch) and 413 for raw bytes. (2) To avoid breaking, accept and drop client-provided `dims` when it differs, but increment a counter `embed_client_dims_ignored` and emit a sample for owners.

Samir K.: The bigger issue is batching at the gateway — our allocator struggles with extreme aggregated payloads and causes head-of-line blocking. Proposal: route big/denser payloads to Dedicated pools or to an async ingestion path that returns a job id + poll. Add a hint header `X-Async-Estimate: true` so clients opt-in.

Roberta (eng-runtime): Routing rule idea: `if payload_bytes > 2MB AND avg_dims > 4096 -> route=dedicated-dense`. We'll need to gate by org quota so free-tier can't spam. Also fallback: if dedicated full, return 429 with `Retry-After` and a `x-fallback: async` suggestion header.

Lina T.: From telemetry we need: a histogram `embed_payload_bytes`, counter `embed_dim_mismatch`, counter `embed_client_dims_ignored`, and tag all by `org_id`, `model`, `route`. Console should show top-10 offending orgs by bytes in last 24h and surface a scrubbed sample of the request body for debugging.

embed-bot: deploy-notification: `validation-v2` rolled to canary on eng-runtime small farm at 2024-06-20T14:22Z by @rob.

Kevin J.: Rollout UX suggestion: add a per-org 'strict validation' toggle in the console default=off. When toggled on, run in dry-run for 7d and show `validation_fail_rate` and sample requests. After 2 weeks let customers opt into hard rejects. That minimizes surprise.

Samir K.: Also API semantics doc update: treat client `dims` as advisory only. Server determines final dims; we'll mark client `dims` deprecated with a 2-month notice and publish migration guidance.

Roberta (eng-runtime): I'll open PRs: 1) router rule + routing tests, 2) gateway validator fallback to drop `dims` and emit counter. Lina: can you own console tile and the telemetry panel? Also we should create a quota rule: payload_bytes > 10MB require enterprise opt-in or explicit escalation.

Lina T.: On it. I'll wire up the dashboard, add a scrubber for samples (strip PII), and add an alert: `embed_dim_mismatch_rate > 0.5% for 5m` (pager to oncall). Will add a per-route column in the Console per-route view.

Samir K.: :thumbsup: Thanks — I'll draft the rollout plan and deprecation email. Let's track a small prod rollout doc and schedule a sync if any of the telemetry shows unexpected customer impact.
